metadata.description: Per-task model routing for AI coding tools: send each piece of work to a fast, standard or deep model with shared per-project rules. A Claude Code plugin with token reports and proof of which model ran, plus a setup script for Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Routes each task to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus by difficulty, ambiguity and risk, or by your own per-project rules. Escalates on failure, announces every routing decision, and reports tokens per model with proof of which model answered.
